arms.A0: SEG-072 qualified development corpus only (Genesis, the other 10 lineages per fold)
arms.A81: A0 + SEG-081 TAS strong labels (vm2, bnr, ewj2)
arms.A83: A0 + SEG-083 TAS strong labels (shadowrun, doraemon, terminator)
arms.A_all: A0 + all six qualified TAS strong labels; Sonic 2 (SEG-080) excluded (the same image is the registry's D01 member: no duplicate training, no extra lineage count)
arms.A_all_W: A0 + TAS strong+weak labels with cell weights (seg084.a_weighted.v1); not the original model A
arms.A_control: A0 + the matching control strong labels of the same six games (SEG-081: player-1-only primary; SEG-083: all-controller primary)
arms.A_control_W: A0 + control strong+weak labels with cell weights (seg084.a_weighted.v1)
arms.A_matched: A0 + TAS strong labels randomly down-sampled (seed 84) to each game's control positive / negative cell counts
arms.A_noterm: A0 + the five other TAS strong labels (A_all without The Terminator)
arms.A_term: A0 + The Terminator TAS strong labels only (low code yield, 2,117 strong hard-negative cells)

evaluation.caution: development folds are reused and lineage-max ER is outlier-driven: differences inside the noise reference are not evidence; nothing here is confirmatory generalisation
evaluation.cost: per-arm CPU seconds of the fit and inference seconds per held-out lineage
evaluation.metrics: SEG-076 definitions unchanged: segarecomp_xplat_explore_eval.image_metrics_ext / lineage_summary / summary (excess retention ER, lineage-max ER, Genesis mean and worst ER, B35/B50 region retention and misses, boundary strata); AP / AUC are secondary context
evaluation.negative_errors: operating point = the A0 fold score at the 10th percentile of positive labelled cells (A0 recall 0.90); every arm is judged at it: false-positive rate on negative cells, on hard-negative cells (genesis_bizhawk.hard_cells) and negative cells admitted at B35/B50
evaluation.scheme: strict leave-one-lineage-out over the 11 qualified SEG-072 lineages (the SEG-076 C0 folds): a held-out lineage contributes no image to training

isolation.code_shingles: 12-byte shingle containment of labelled code runs (TAS strong U control strong) against the held-out lineage's labelled code, either direction, > 0.30 withholds the game from that fold (SEG-081 rule)
isolation.image: a TAS ROM whose SHA-256 equals a registry image is excluded
isolation.lineage: TAS lineage ids are outside the D## namespace
isolation.sealed: no sealed, reserved or blind path is read (refuse_sealed); the SEG-075 cross-platform dev samples are not used (SEG-076 A used the Genesis corpus only)

limits.fits: 13 arms x 11 folds, one fit each (A is deterministic)
limits.no: hyperparameter search, B / C / C-v2 training, sealed data, retracing, new games

model.features: segarecomp_xplat_models.a_features(im, relocs_of(im)) (token aggregates, ordinary-decode chains, PC-relative targets, byte statistics, relocations, seed flag, PROVEN reach from seed addresses, +/-1 and +/-4 neighbour means)
model.fit: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**A_CONFIG) with class_weight balanced, random_state 49, on the pooled labelled 128-byte cells (masked cells excluded)
model.reproduction_gate: A0 for every fold must equal the stored SEG-076 T001 A.C0.<fold> scores bitwise; otherwise EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
model.unchanged_modules: imported unchanged: xplat_models, xplat_explore_eval, xplat_transfer, xplat_t005, ml_v3*, gen2_train
model.weighted_path: seg084.a_weighted.v1: optional per-cell sample_weight (1.0 strong-only evidence, 0.25 weak; masked excluded) used ONLY by ['A_all_W', 'A_control_W']; weights=None is byte-identical to fit_a; weighted arms are NOT called the original model A

reported_separately: effective independent lineages supplying each kind
negative_supervision.terminator: legitimacy of its strong negatives is checked against the tier definitions (strong D = H header + M DMA-source tiers only) and their non-triviality by the fraction of their words with an ordinary decode; their value by A_term vs A0 and A_noterm vs A_all on the held-out hard-negative and negative-admitted slices
negative_supervision.weak_vs_strong: A_all_W vs A_all and A_control_W vs A_control; no reference truth repairs any commercial label

noise_reference.method: A0 refitted on a random 90% of the labelled base cells with seeds [84, 85, 86] (A0_sub1..3); per-fold noise = max |ER(sub) - ER(A0)|
noise_reference.rule: an arm's per-fold ER change counts only if it exceeds that fold's noise; the mean change counts only if it exceeds the mean noise

preserved: ADRs 0181-0187, the SEG-083 frozen plan 228647dd, its decisions (EXPANSION_MIXED, ML_INCONCLUSIVE, MORE_DIVERSITY_NEEDED) and all SEG-076 results are unchanged
privacy: private cell scores and contexts stay in the ignored cache; committed results are aggregate counts, rates and digests

prospective_retention_rule.eligible_when: replay fidelity (identity, played to the end, no perturbation, deterministic, >= 5 distinct states, complete domains) AND label consistency AND sound tracing; yield and the number of movie fifths with new code are irrelevant; a tracing failure that is solely accepted-executed fraction < 0.99 is waived only when every rejected start is classified DISASSEMBLER_LIMITATION by the bounded diagnostic
prospective_retention_rule.purpose: decide, prospectively, which labels of the two SEG-083 games that failed a frozen gate may be retained privately; ADR 0187 and its classes are untouched
prospective_retention_rule.uses: retention only; the labels are not part of any A arm in this study

purpose: reassess the data contribution of the SEG-081 / SEG-083 TAS labels with the TRUE SEG-076 structural model A (a_features + A_CONFIG), not the SEG-072 M1-HGB of the SEG-083 diagnostic; decide readiness for a bounded B / C-v2 pilot with code diversity and negative-supervision diversity judged separately

readiness.code_diversity: independent useful lineages among the eight SEG-081/083 candidates (SEG-083 rule: code yield >= usefulness criterion, shingle containment <= 0.30) >= 5 AND the six qualified games' strong positive cells >= 20 % of the base positive cells
readiness.expected_from_existing_data: stated before any fit: with the SEG-081/083 results already in hand the code criteria (5 independent useful lineages; strong positive cells of the useful games ~32 % of the base) and the negative criterion (vm2, bnr, ewj2 and The Terminator exceed 300 strong hard-negative cells) are expected to pass, so the decision is expected to hinge on the response and residual rules measured here
readiness.independent_of_SEG-083: this decision does not reinterpret SEG-083's frozen verdict
readiness.negative_diversity: independent qualified lineages with >= 300 strong hard-negative cells, regardless of their code-yield class, >= 3
readiness.order: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT (a required arm missing or A0 not reproduced) -> MORE_DIVERSITY_NEEDED (any diversity criterion unmet) -> MODEL_OR_EVALUATION_LIMITATION (A does not respond beyond noise, or no residual headroom) -> NEURAL_PILOT_JUSTIFIED

recommendation_map.MODEL_OR_EVALUATION_LIMITATION: improve evaluation / source-backed evidence before more acquisition
recommendation_map.NEURAL_PILOT_JUSTIFIED: run a bounded B / C-v2 pilot now (not started automatically)

readiness.residual: folds where A_all still has lineage-max ER >= 0.05 and its gain over A0 is within that fold's noise: >= 2
readiness.response: A_all improves ER beyond the fold noise on >= 2 folds AND the mean ER change exceeds the mean noise AND the response is dose-dependent (mean ER of A_all below that of A_matched, the same TAS labels at the control's volume). Reported, not gating: A_all vs A_control / A_matched per fold (TAS-specific content versus volume), and the negative-slice responses below

seeds.problem: SEG-072 Genesis seeds (`seeds.json`/`d.txt`) are produced by the production CLI `emit-general-startup-bridge-c --reset-entry --direct-control-address-report`, a label-free static direct-flow set; the retained TAS samples carry only the reset vector. Feeding model A the retained seeds would give the TAS images a PROVEN-reach feature distribution unlike every registry image.
seeds.rule: `prepare` regenerates d.txt for each TAS ROM with the same pinned CLI and the SEG-072 procedure (seed cell = address // 128); a ROM the CLI rejects gets no seeds, as the registry's rejected images do. Seeds never use labels.
